description: List alternatives to a given product on Toolfound — tools in the same primary category, ranked by points (community votes plus an AI listing score). Useful for 'alternatives to X' and comparison questions. Each result includes tagline, pricing model, votes, and a canonical listing URL.

slug.description: Slug of the product you want substitutes for, taken from a search result or listing URL. Results are listings in the same category.

name: toolfound_get_alternatives
title: Get alternatives to a product
